source: https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Quest (master progression chain), raw wikitext of one wiki.warframe.com page per quest via index.php?title=<Quest>&action=raw (QuestInfobox requirement / internalname / previousquest / nextquest fields), https://content.warframe.com/PublicExport/index_en.txt.lzma -> https://content.warframe.com/PublicExport/Manifest/ExportKeys_en.json
sourceNote: Hand-constructed: no machine-readable quest-prerequisite dataset exists. DE's ExportKeys carries no prerequisites and WFCD's Quests.json carries none. Every id is a DE-canonical uniqueName copied verbatim from ExportKeys_en.json (PublicExport, fetched 2026-08-31) and cross-checked against each wiki page's QuestInfobox internalname field where present; ids join directly against account QuestKeys[].ItemType. SOURCING RULE for requires: only quests explicitly named in the QuestInfobox 'requirement' field of the page's RAW WIKITEXT are listed. Non-quest gates from that same field (junctions, Mastery Rank, segments, NPC conversations, owning a Railjack or Amp) go in requiresNote. Where the infobox 'previousquest' names a narrative predecessor that is NOT in the requirement field (Vox Solaris, Once Awake, Heart of Deimos, The Archwing, Stolen Dreams, The Deadlock Protocol, Natah, Chains of Harrow), that predecessor is recorded in 'note' and deliberately NOT in requires: those quests are gated only by a junction, so a false edge would hide a quest the player can actually start. Wiki pages were read as raw wikitext through a browser session. Rendered-page summarisation was NOT used for prerequisites: on this wiki it produced inconsistent results, inventing gates (a Europa Junction on The New Strange, a Jupiter-to-Europa Junction on The Limbo Theorem, a Mastery Rank on Natah, a Venus Junction on Vox Solaris) that the raw infoboxes do not contain. Those four are corrected here. 'The Maker' has id null: the wiki types it a Main Quest but it is a pure cutscene with no internalname and no key in ExportKeys, so it can never appear in account data. It is referenced by name in The New War's requires. 'Prelude to War' has no row: its own page types it 'Narrative arc' rather than a quest and it has no key. The New War's infobox requirement 'Completed Prelude to War' is expanded into its three chapters, Chimera Prologue -> Erra -> The Maker. 'The Hex Finale' is a real separate key in ExportKeys but the wiki page of that name redirects into a section of The Hex, so it has no infobox; its gate comes from that section's prose. ExportKeys holds 46 entries, two of which are not quests and are excluded: /Lotus/Types/Keys/DojoKey and /Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/AssassinateInfestedAladVKey ('Mutalist Alad V Assassinate', a mission key). All 44 remaining quest keychains are represented here, plus The Maker. The announced but unreleased 'Unnamed Warframe: Tau Quest' (Warframe: Tau, Winter 2026) is excluded: it has no key and its own wiki page marks its prerequisite as speculation. 'order' is a best-judgment completionist sequence derived from junction gates, Mastery gates and the master progression chain on /w/Quest. It is not an authoritative DE ordering, and it is validated only to the extent that every quest is ordered after all of its requires. Current as of Update 43 (Jade Shadows: Constellations).

quests.name: Awakening
quests.note: Tutorial.
quests.provenance: DE spells the name 'AWAKENING' in ExportKeys.

quests.name: Vor's Prize
quests.note: Mandatory. Nothing else opens until it is done.

quests.name: The Teacher
unlocks: Cetus and the Plains of Eidolon
quests.note: Added in Update 40 (2025-10-15) and retroactively inserted into early progression. It now sits between Vor's Prize and Vox Solaris, and the Venus Junction lists it as a task.

quests.name: Saya's Vigil
unlocks: Ostron standing, fishing, mining, conservation, Zaw crafting

quests.name: A Man of Few Words
quests.requiresNote: Talk with Darvo in any Relay
quests.provenance: The infobox names no quest or junction gate at all, only the Darvo conversation.

quests.name: Vox Solaris
quests.note: Reaching Fortuna needs Venus unlocked. The Vox Solaris syndicate, as opposed to this quest, additionally needs The War Within.
quests.provenance: The infobox requirement is only the Eudico conversation, so requires is empty; the infobox previousquest is The Teacher.

quests.name: Once Awake
quests.note: Gated only by the Mercury Junction.
quests.provenance: The infobox previousquest is Vox Solaris.

quests.name: Heart of Deimos
quests.note: Gated only by the Earth to Mars Junction.
quests.provenance: The infobox previousquest is Once Awake.

quests.name: The Archwing
quests.note: Gated only by the Mars Junction.
quests.provenance: The infobox previousquest is Heart of Deimos.

quests.name: Stolen Dreams
quests.note: Formerly a main quest, now typed a side quest.
quests.provenance: The infobox previousquest is The Archwing.

quests.name: The New Strange
quests.note: Stolen Dreams is the only stated requirement.
quests.provenance: The infobox names Stolen Dreams as the only requirement. Page prose also mentions Cephalon Simaris in a Relay, but that is not stated as a gate.

quests.name: The Limbo Theorem
quests.note: Requires an Archwing. No junction gate.
quests.provenance: The infobox requirement is only 'Obtain an Archwing' -- no junction is listed.

quests.name: The Deadlock Protocol
quests.provenance: The infobox previousquest is Vox Solaris, but no quest appears in the requirement field.

quests.name: The Duviri Paradox
unlocks: The Circuit, The Duviri Experience, The Lone Story
quests.note: Solo only. Startable this early, but it is written to be played after The New War.
quests.provenance: The infobox lists no previousquest.

quests.name: Natah
quests.note: Gated only by the Uranus Junction. A Mastery Rank gate that some sources cite is not confirmed.
quests.provenance: The infobox requirement is only the Uranus Junction; the infobox previousquest is The Archwing. The Mastery Rank gate is not in the infobox.

quests.name: The Second Dream
quests.note: The single biggest story gate in the game.

quests.name: Octavia's Anthem
quests.note: Started by speaking to Cephalon Suda in a Relay.
quests.provenance: The infobox lists only The Second Dream.

quests.name: The Silver Grove
quests.note: Started by speaking to Amaryn (New Loka) in a Relay; no New Loka standing is required.

quests.name: The War Within
unlocks: The Quills, Vox Solaris and Necraloid syndicates
quests.note: A former Mastery Rank 5 gate was removed in Update 35.
quests.provenance: It is no longer in the infobox.

quests.name: The Glast Gambit
quests.note: Started by speaking to Ergo Glast in the Perrin Sequence room of any Relay; no standing needed.

quests.name: Rising Tide
quests.note: Needs Dry Dock access to build the Railjack. Buying a built Railjack for Platinum auto-completes it.

quests.name: Call of the Tempestarii
quests.requiresNote: Own a Railjack and retrieved Reliquary Key; Mastery Rank 4
unlocks: Sisters of Parvos (with The War Within)
quests.note: Needs a Railjack. Owning one is enough, so Rising Tide is not required by name -- a purchased Railjack also satisfies it.
quests.provenance: The infobox says 'own a Railjack', not Rising Tide by name, so Rising Tide is deliberately not a requires edge.

quests.name: The Jordas Precept
quests.note: The final mission is Archwing.
quests.provenance: The infobox lists only the junction.

quests.name: Patient Zero
unlocks: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate key blueprint

quests.name: Sands of Inaros
quests.note: Mastery Rank 5, and in practice the quest blueprint must be bought from Baro Ki'Teer and crafted before the quest appears.
quests.provenance: Mastery Rank 5 is the only infobox gate.

quests.name: Mask of the Revenant
quests.note: The Quills only become available after The War Within, so it is effectively gated behind it. Started by buying the Mask of the Lost One from Nakak in Cetus.
quests.provenance: No quest is named in the infobox.

quests.name: Chains of Harrow
quests.provenance: The infobox previousquest is Rising Tide, but only The War Within appears in the requirement field.

quests.name: Apostasy Prologue
quests.note: Started by touching the violet orb in the Personal Quarters, not from the Codex.

quests.name: Chimera Prologue
quests.note: First of the three Prelude to War chapters.

quests.name: Erra
quests.note: Second Prelude to War chapter.

quests.name: The Maker
quests.note: Third and final Prelude to War chapter.
quests.provenance: The wiki types it as a Main Quest but the page has no internalname and ExportKeys has no key for it, so id is null and it can never appear in account QuestKeys. It is referenced by name in The New War's requires.

quests.name: The New War
quests.requiresNote: Own a Railjack; own an Amp
quests.note: Needs Prelude to War completed, plus a Railjack and an Amp.
quests.provenance: The infobox requirement is 'Completed Prelude to War' plus a Railjack and an Amp. Prelude to War has no quest key, so it is expanded here into its three chapters.

quests.name: Angels of the Zariman
unlocks: Zariman Ten Zero nodes and the Chrysalith
Void Cascade, Void Flood, Void Armageddon
quests.note: Non-replayable.

quests.name: Veilbreaker
unlocks: Archon Shards and the Helminth Archon Shard Segment
quests.provenance: Typed Side Quest by the wiki despite being listed under The New War's nextquest.

quests.name: Jade Shadows: Constellations
unlocks: Pontis Tower hub with Hunhow as vendor
quests.note: Newest released quest in this dataset: Update 43. Non-replayable.

quests.name: Whispers in the Walls
quests.provenance: One of the few quests whose infobox names two required quests.

quests.name: The Lotus Eaters
quests.note: Short solo-only prologue to The Hex, Update 36.1. Non-replayable.

quests.name: The Hex
unlocks: The Backroom as a Base of Operations
quests.note: Update 38. Needs both The Duviri Paradox and The Lotus Eaters.
quests.provenance: The infobox names both.

quests.name: The Hex Finale
quests.requiresNote: Rank 3 (2-for-1) with The Hex syndicate, and 'Liked' Chemistry Rank with all six Hex members on KIM
unlocks: Alternative ending in which the Hex survive
quests.provenance: A real, separate quest key in ExportKeys, but the wiki covers it only as the Finale section of The Hex (the page The Hex Finale is a redirect), so it has no infobox of its own; the gate above is taken from that section’s prose.

quests.name: The Old Peace
unlocks: La Cathedrale via the Sanctum Anatomica
The Perita Rebellion and The Descendia
quests.note: Update 41 (2025-12-10). Currently the last released quest in the story chain.
quests.provenance: The wiki lists its nextquest as the unnamed Warframe: Tau quest slated for Winter 2026.
